Лактоферрин.about: Milk glycoprotein: preterm lower late sepsis (2 Cochrane); children - sepsis and diarrhea, not ARI.
Лактоферрин.caution: Lactoferrin is a milk glycoprotein. For prematurity: 2 Cochrane reviews support prevention of late-onset sepsis and NEC. For pediatric infections: data available. For iron status: improves absorption. Safe. Caution: milk protein allergy.
Лактоферрин.food_sources: Lactoferrin - in breast milk (especially colostrum) and cow's milk; additive - extracted protein.
Лактоферрин.guidelines: Cochrane 2020 (12 RCT, 5425): late sepsis RR 0.82, NNTB 25, low quality. MA 2025: sepsis OR 0.60, diarrhea 0.56.
Лактоферрин.how_to_choose: 100-200 mg/day lactoferrin; for premature babies - only for their intended purpose; Be careful if you are allergic to milk.
mechs: Antimicrobial protection in premature infants (intestinal barrier)
Late sepsis: RR 0.82 (12 RCT, 5425, low confidence); NNTB 25
Pediatrics: sepsis OR 0.60, diarrhea OR 0.56; ARI without effect (25 studies)
Лактоферрин.myths: “Kills all infections” - from ARI in children without effect (OR 0.61, NS). “Works in adults” – neonatal/pediatric evidence.
Лактоферрин.name: Lactoferrin
Лактоферрин.onset: Preventive and course: in premature infants with regular addition to the diet.
Лактоферрин.title: Lactoferrin
Лактоферрин.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Лактоферрин.who_needs: Premature under medical supervision (prevention of late sepsis, NNTB 25); children with frequent intestinal/septic infections.
